#! -rules CONF-11 -strict
# Level sets applied in cmake/HeliosIsa.cmake, baseline pins (x86-64-v1 too), SSE4.2, names in comments
# and messages, and try-compile probe flags; quoted foreach items that name a flag in a sentence, and a
# loop variable after its loop.
# ZIP_LISTS: only the loop variable that takes the flags list holds them (_pcg_o and _pcg_z_1 do not),
# and every loop variable is restored when the loop ends (_pcg_a2); literal baseline levels.
# $ENV{} in a CMAKE_ variable that holds no compiler flags, and in a command that grants nothing.
# Round 8: $ENV{} in a probe's CMAKE_REQUIRED_FLAGS, the environment's CXXFLAGS appended to itself, a
# string(REPLACE) whose match string names $ENV{}, $ENV{} inside the level function, a target feature turned
# off, and a define value that only spells one (`=sse4+avx2`: a `+feature` counts only where no letter,
# digit or underscore precedes the `+`).
